'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Mark Billings LS hidden path''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Billings]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Billings]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train|V26-L-thehiddenpath.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Tatooine Billings LS Hidden Path.txt |Download]]
